declaration.preface:
Gautam Solar Private Limited is committed to conducting all business activities with the highest standards of integrity, transparency, and accountability. The Company has zero tolerance for bribery, corruption, fraud, money laundering, and unethical conduct. Furthermore, the Company respects the confidentiality and security of third‑party information entrusted to it.

This policy aligns with applicable laws including the Prevention of Corruption Act (India), Companies Act 2013, Information Technology Act 2000 (with SPDI Rules), GDPR (where applicable), and international frameworks such as the UN Convention against Corruption (UNCAC) and the OECD Anti‑Bribery Convention.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, directors, officers, contractors, sub‑contractors, agents, consultants, suppliers, and any third parties acting on behalf of Gautam Solar Private Limited. It covers all business dealings, regardless of location or jurisdiction.

Anti‑Bribery & Corruption: Prohibit offering, promising, giving, accepting, or soliciting any undue advantage (cash, gifts, entertainment, travel, favours, etc.) to improperly influence business decisions
Maintain accurate books and records with no off‑book accounts or hidden transactions
Require due diligence on third‑party intermediaries (agents, consultants, distributors)
Do report any offer of a bribe or improper gift to your manager or the Compliance Officer
Do keep accurate and transparent records of all business expenses and transactions
Do conduct due diligence on third‑party agents, consultants, and distributors before engagement
Do refuse any payment or favour that could be perceived as influencing a business decision
Don’t offer, promise, give, or accept any cash, gift, travel, entertainment, or favour to influence a business decision
Don’t use intermediaries or agents to make improper payments on the company’s behalf
Don’t create off‑book accounts or unrecorded funds
Don’t ignore red flags (e.g., a supplier demanding unusual commissions)

Accepting or offering a bribe, any amount, may result in immediate termination of employment or contract, forfeiture of bonuses, incentives, or severance, blacklisting from future engagement with Gautam Solar, and referral to law enforcement (criminal or civil proceedings).
Conflict of Interest: Require employees to disclose any personal, financial, or family interests that may influence their decision‑making
Prohibit participation in decisions where a conflict exists
Ensure that outside employment, investments, or relationships do not interfere with company duties
Do disclose any personal, financial, or family interests that may conflict with company duties immediately
Do recuse yourself from any decision‑making process where a conflict exists
Do seek prior written approval from HR/Compliance before accepting outside employment or directorships
Don’t participate in hiring, contracting, or evaluation decisions involving a relative or close friend
Don’t hold a significant financial interest in a competitor, supplier, or customer without disclosure
Don’t use company time, assets, or information for personal business
Fraud Prevention: Prohibit any act of intentional deception, misrepresentation, forgery, or concealment intended to gain an unfair or illegal advantage
Implement internal controls to detect and prevent fraudulent financial reporting, asset misappropriation, procurement fraud, or expense reimbursement fraud
Do verify all invoices, expense claims, and purchase orders for accuracy before approval
Do report any suspected fraud (e.g., forged signatures, false claims, asset theft) through the whistleblower channel
Do follow the company’s delegated authority matrix for approvals
Don’t forge signatures, alter documents, or misrepresent information
Don’t claim reimbursement for personal or fictitious expenses
Don’t circumvent approval limits or split purchases to avoid thresholds
Don’t destroy, hide, or falsify financial records

Fraud involving falsifying records, asset theft, or forged approvals may result in immediate termination of employment or contract, forfeiture of bonuses, incentives, or severance, blacklisting from future engagement with Gautam Solar, and referral to law enforcement (criminal or civil proceedings).
Anti‑Money Laundering: Prohibit using company operations to conceal the origin, ownership, or destination of illegally obtained money
Ensure all significant transactions are legitimate, properly recorded, and reported as required by law
Conduct customer/supplier due diligence to avoid association with money laundering or terrorist financing
Do verify the identity and background of new customers, suppliers, and partners
Do report any suspicious transaction (e.g., unusual cash payments, round‑tripping, unexplained large transfers)
Do maintain records of all significant transactions as per legal retention periods
Don’t process transactions that you suspect involve illegally obtained money
Don’t accept cash payments above the legal limit without proper documentation
Don’t structure transactions to avoid reporting requirements
Don’t ignore unusual payment patterns from customers or partners

Money laundering or suspicious transaction concealment may result in immediate termination of employment or contract, forfeiture of bonuses, incentives, or severance, blacklisting from future engagement with Gautam Solar, and referral to law enforcement (criminal or civil proceedings).
Confidential Information Protection: Ensure secure collection, processing, and storage of third‑party confidential information (customer data, supplier data, partner data, trade secrets) for business purposes
Comply with applicable data protection laws (e.g., IT Act, DPDP Act 2023, GDPR)
Limit access to authorised personnel only and implement technical safeguards (encryption, access controls, breach notification)
Do store confidential data on company‑approved, encrypted systems
Do use strong passwords and enable multi‑factor authentication
Do report any data breach or unauthorised access immediately to IT / DPO
Do shred or securely delete physical documents containing confidential information
Don’t share passwords or leave confidential documents unattended
Don’t email confidential information to personal accounts or unauthorised recipients
Don’t discuss confidential matters in public places (elevators, cafeterias, taxis)
Don’t use unapproved cloud storage or USB drives for company data

Deliberate, unauthorised sale or leak of confidential information for personal gain may result in immediate termination of employment or contract, forfeiture of bonuses, incentives, or severance, blacklisting from future engagement with Gautam Solar, and referral to law enforcement (criminal or civil proceedings).
Policy-wide: Violation of this Business Integrity & Confidential Information Policy is a serious matter. Depending on the nature, severity, and frequency of the violation, the Company may take one or more of the following disciplinary actions, up to and including termination of employment or contract, and potential legal proceedings.
All disciplinary actions shall follow the Company’s progressive discipline policy and principles of natural justice (notice, opportunity to be heard).
Retaliation against any employee who reports a violation in good faith is itself a serious violation and will result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination.
Contractors, consultants, and third parties found in violation may have their contracts terminated immediately and be placed on a debarment list.
The Compliance Officer (in consultation with HR and Legal) shall determine the appropriate action based on investigation findings.

targets.target: 100% of employees and relevant third party’s complete annual anti‑bribery training
Zero substantiated incidents of bribery or corruption annually
100% of high‑risk third parties (agents, consultants) undergo due diligence before engagement
100% of employees in managerial or procurement roles submit annual conflict of interest disclosure
100% of disclosed conflicts reviewed and resolved within 30 days
Zero instances of undisclosed conflicts resulting in disciplinary action
Zero material fraud incidents (loss > ₹1 lakh) annually
100% of fraud allegations investigated within 15 working days
100% of identified fraud control gaps remediated within 60 days
100% of high‑value transactions (> ₹10 lakh) reviewed for AML compliance
Zero regulatory penalties related to money laundering
100% of new business partners screened against government watchlists
100% of systems processing confidential third‑party information have encryption and access logs
Zero reportable data breaches involving confidential information
100% of employees handling confidential data complete privacy training annually

responsibilities.duty: Overall ownership of this policy, including anti‑bribery, conflict of interest, fraud, and AML
Conduct training, investigations, and due diligence reviews
Maintain whistleblower mechanisms and report to Top Management
Implement internal controls to prevent fraud and money laundering
Review high‑value transactions and maintain transparent records
Ensure secure collection, processing, and storage of confidential information
Implement encryption, access controls, and breach response procedures
Integrate conflict of interest disclosures into annual declarations
Enforce disciplinary actions for policy violations
Approve policy updates and review incident reports quarterly
Report any suspected bribery, conflict, fraud, money laundering, or data breach through the whistleblower channel
Never use company assets or position for personal gain

policy.monitoring:
The Company shall monitor compliance through:

Annual mandatory training with completion tracking

Quarterly compliance audits (internal or external)

Whistleblower hotline (anonymous, accessible 24/7)

Review of high‑value transactions and third‑party due diligence logs

Corrective action plans shall be developed for any missed targets or violations.
policy.reviewMechanism:
This policy and its targets shall be reviewed annually by the Compliance Officer and Top Management.
